name: Face Chart
tagline: Makeup looks built around your face and your kit
about: Face Chart builds makeup looks from the products you already own, matches your undertone from a daylight photo, audits your kit for expired products and rescues looks that went wrong.
persona: You are a working makeup artist: skin-first, technique over product, honest about what is worth the money and strict about hygiene.

onboarding.title: Your face, your rules
onboarding.subtitle: Skin, eye shape and the kit you own shape every look.
bullets: Looks from the products you own
Kit audit: what to keep, what to toss

tools.title: Build a look
tools.subtitle: Occasion + products → steps

inputs.label: Products you own
inputs.placeholder: tinted moisturiser, brown pencil, mascara, cream blush…

tools.prompt: Design a {occasion} makeup look in {minutes} minutes using mostly: {kit}, for the profile's skin type, eye shape and experience. Steps in application order naming the product and placement for each, kv (finish, key colours, longevity tricks), bullets of what to buy if one thing is missing, and a callout on the step most people rush.

tools.title: Match my undertone
tools.subtitle: Photo → warm, cool or neutral

inputs.label: Photo of your face or inner wrist in daylight

tools.prompt: Estimate undertone and depth from the photo, given the current foundation '{current}'. kv (undertone, depth, surface tone, jewellery metal that flatters), a table (Product | Shade descriptor to look for | Words to avoid on labels), bullets on swatch-testing in store, and a callout that photo lighting can mislead so confirm with a jaw swatch in daylight.

tools.title: Audit my kit
tools.subtitle: Photo of your bag → keep or toss

inputs.label: Photo of your makeup bag emptied out

tools.prompt: Catalogue every product visible in the photo as a table (Product | Type | Typical shelf life | Verdict: keep / test / toss), a checklist for cleaning brushes and sponges this week, bullets on the gaps in the kit for the profile, and a callout on eye-area products that must never be shared or kept past date.

tools.title: Rescue this look
tools.subtitle: Something went wrong
tools.prompt: Fix '{problem}' right now without starting over, using the photo if one is given. Steps (fastest fix first, each under a minute), text on why it happened for the profile's skin type, bullets on preventing it next time, and a quote with a one-line rule to remember.

tools.title: My 5-minute face
tools.subtitle: Built from your profile alone
tools.prompt: Design a daily 5-minute face for the profile's skin type, eye shape and experience. Steps with a time budget per step totalling 5 minutes, kv (the 5 products that make it work, in order), and bullets of 3 add-ons that turn it into an evening look.

disclaimer: Beauty guidance only; patch-test new products and see a doctor for rashes, swelling or eye irritation.
